u_definition_verified_from_source.per_atom: u_alpha = sqrt( sum_xyz Var_members(F_alpha,xyz) ) = Euclidean norm of per-component committee population std for atom alpha
u_definition_verified_from_source.basis: force-based; NOT normalized by |F|; population std (ddof=0) over the 4 committee members
u_definition_verified_from_source.aggregation: per frame: u_mean = mean over atoms, u_max = max over atoms; across frames: distribution stats (min/median/mean/max, percentiles)

coded_constant.usage: per-atom EXCEEDANCE FRACTION frac(u_alpha>0.15), NOT a pass/fail gate on u_max

the_0_30_claim: u_max<0.30 is NOT a coded gate — 0.30 is only the top of a cited literature range and the magnitude of observed u_max (~0.25-0.62 eV/A on production defect MD). Prior 'u_max<0.30 gate' wording was inaccurate.
